d:
Diwali par bina chhena ke Suji Rasmalai banayein
Idli mould aur Eno se spongy rasmalai, beginners ke liye bhi aasan!
Suji se rasmalai ki spongy idli banana
Kaju-cheeni-elaichi powder aur kesar wala rabdi jaisa doodh
Idli ko doodh mein bhigoyein, ubalein nahi - soft rasmalai ka secret
Comment karein - Aap Diwali par kaunsi mithai banayengi?
CHAPTERS:
Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani: suji phulayi, Eno se idli steam ki, kesar-kaju doodh mein bhigoyi. Utni hi banayein jitni ek-do din mein khatam ho.
